900.name: You spy a sapphire glimmer in the nearby waters.
900.description: The sapphire glimmer flickers and fades...
900.col_2: You catch another glimpse of the sapphire glimmer!

917.name: You sense the movements of an unexpected predator!
917.description: The predator seems to have moved on...

1013.name: A scarlet streak rises from the depths!
1013.description: The scarlet streak seems to dissipate...
1013.col_2: The scarlet streak rises once more!
